items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: the flute player would come in actually and he would play and that would be — and he wouldn’t be able to do anything that Trane did actually.

ctx.x: What about his later — well not specifically “Ascension” but some of the LPs near the end of his life were — I’m trying to think of the word — sometimes they sounded angry, over the top with Pharoah Sanders and so forth, did this still hold your interest?

No. No now even the club actually there were — there is one name that I don’t have over here, the flute player would come in actually and he would play and that would be — and he wouldn’t be able to do anything that Trane did actually. It was a little embarrassing.
You’re not talking about Eric Dolphy?
